title: Using Student Questions in Instruction
before:
The Question Formulation Technique and student-led inquiry focus on student-developed questions that drive instruction, but what about all the questions that students generate that won't be used during instruction?  The video and resources below discuss ideas to address all student questions.

decisions.label: Put the card titles on one level
decisions.why: 1 card title is written at a level copied from an example rather than chosen — h5 on a page whose sections are h2. Only the number changes.

decisions.label: Let a lone card use the full width
decisions.why: 1 row holds a single card in a part-width column, so it takes a third or a half of the page and the rest is blank. A row of one is not a grid.
